'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**Seven people are killed when a vehicle carrying oil workers hits a [[roadside bomb]] in [[Balkh Province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-five-killed-blast-northern-afghanistan-police-2022-12-06/ (Reuters)]
**Six people are injured in an [[explosion]] at a money exchange market in [[Jalalabad]], [[Nangarhar Province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/blast-injures-six-near-money-market-eastern-afghan-city-police-2022-12-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[South Thailand insurgency]]
**Three people are killed and four others are injured in a bombing near [[Khlong Ngae railway station]], [[Phang Nga]], [[Thailand]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-bombings-6d8ba862459ffed58f5f4e952f443b41 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[2022 food crises]]
***[[Economy of the Philippines]]
****[[Inflation]] in the [[Philippines]] reaches a 14-year record high of 8% due to increases in food prices. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/12/06/philippines-inflation-soars-to-fastest-in-14-years-more-hikes-to-come.html (CNBC)]
*[[Boeing 747]]
**The 1,574th and final Boeing 747, an [[Atlas Air]] [[Boeing 747-8F|747-8 Freighter]], is rolled out from the [[Boeing Everett Factory]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/12/06/boeing-747-production-is-ending-with-shift-to-twin-engine-jets.html (CNBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Accession of Kosovo to the European Union]]
**[[President of Kosovo]] [[Vjosa Osmani]] announces that the country will submit an application for membership of the [[European Union]] by the end of the year. [https://tvpworld.com/64935543/kosovos-president-announces-application-for-eu-membership-by-yearend (TVP World)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[New York investigations of The Trump Organization]]
**A jury finds the [[Trump Organization]] guilty of tax fraud charges. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/12/06/nyregion/trump-organization-trial-verdict (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2022 Honduran gang crackdown]]
**[[Honduras]] begins a partial [[state of exception]] in most of the country as part of an attempt to reduce the amount of violent [[organized crime]]. [https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2022/12/06/ultimas-noticias-breves-del-mundo-hoy-6-de-diciembre-2022/ (CNN en Español)]
*[[Vice President of Argentina|Argentine Vice President]] [[Cristina Fernández de Kirchner]] is sentenced to six years in prison on corruption charges, with Kirchner also receiving a lifetime ban on holding public office. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentine-court-sentences-vp-fernandez-de-kirchner-to-6-years-prison-graft-case-2022-12-06/ (Reuters)] [https://brazilian.report/liveblog/2022/12/06/argentina-cristina-kirchner-sentenced-corruption-trial/ (The Brazilian Report)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 United States Senate election in Georgia]]
**Voters in the [[United States|U.S.]] state of [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] go to the polls to elect their next Senator in a runoff election between the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] incumbent candidate [[Raphael Warnock]] and [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] candidate [[Herschel Walker]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/dec/05/georgia-runoff-raphael-warnock-herschel-walker-democrats (''The Guardian'')]
**Warnock wins re-election, bringing the Democratic majority in the Senate up to 51–49. [https://apnews.com/article/2022-midterm-elections-walker-warnock-runoff-3d4e4d1ab1760792454e1cbd618ce332 (AP)]
*[[2022 Dominican general election]]
**[[People of Dominica|Dominicans]] go to the polls to elect the members of the [[House of Assembly of Dominica|House of Assembly]]. [https://today.caricom.org/2022/11/07/pm-skerrit-announces-snap-election-in-dominica/ (CARICOM Daily)]
*The [[People's Representative Council]] of [[Indonesia]] replaces the country's [[Dutch East Indies|colonial-era]] [[Indonesian criminal code|criminal code]] with a new code that criminalizes [[Premarital sex|premarital]] and [[extramarital sex]] and [[cohabitation]], among other changes. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2022/12/858128/indonesian-parliament-approves-legislation-outlaw-extra-marital-sex (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]
